pages.text: The Rite of Beastial Call is a large Otherwhere working for drawing animal life into the circle from the surrounding countryside.$(br2)It is less a summoning than a lure. The rite coaxes nearby creatures to answer a call they do not understand and gathers them at the center whether they came from the wild or from someone's pasture.

Prepare the circle with offerings that speak of barn, field, and bait: a milk bucket, hay bale, apple, beef, cod, red mushroom, carrot, and seeds, plus $(bold)6000 altar power$(/).$(br2)The rite favors the ordinary creatures of the world: pigs, chickens, cows, sheep, mooshrooms, wolves, and ocelots.

pages.title: Practical Use
pages.text: Use it when you need living creatures gathered in one place for breeding, selection, sacrifice, or later workings. Do not cast it carelessly near a village ranch unless you are willing to explain yourself afterward.$(br2)A coven of three or more makes the call more fitting for the old craft.
